g.text: Noise-free Brune spectrum · observed-band integrals evaluated analytically · tail equations solved jointly
Panels a–c compare the two implementations, each iterated to convergence; they are not errors relative to the true source.
Panel d compares the self-consistent finite-band estimate with the true Brune input. The coefficient does not remove tail-approximation error.
